verdict.rationale: The Needle README documents grammar-constrained decoding: you declare a shape, pass messy text, and get typed fields back, with "the decode grammar guarantees the output parses" (cactus-compute-docs-15). A hands-on user also reported a clean JSON doc from a multi-intent request (cactus-compute-comm-11). Support is thin, though: it is a single README line tied to the Needle model, and nothing shows it on the OpenAI-compatible Cactus Engine serving API. missing for 10: user-supplied grammars or JSON Schema, a response_format/structured-output parameter on the serving API, coverage across models beyond Needle, in-depth documentation of the grammar feature.
